===Ritual===
{{Checklist|
*Talk to [[Denath]] on the other side of the portal. {{Chat option|4What do I have to do?}}
*Talk to [[Jennifer]] to get a [[demonic sigil mould]]. {{Chat option|2Do you have the demonic sigil mould?}}
*Talk to [[Matthew]]. {{Chat option|3Do you know what happened to Josef?}}
*Go to any [[furnace]] and smelt a [[demonic sigil]] (use [[silver bar]] on furnace and select 'demonic sigil').
*Your black outfit can now be discarded and replaced with combat gear (keep Silverlight with you).
*Head back to Uzer and talk to the clay golem outside about last night. {{Chat option|3Did you see anything happen last night?}}
*Search the nearby kilns for a book (there are four kilns – the last two are on the east side of the ruin, and by the magic carpet).
*Read the book, and take it to Matthew on the other side of the portal
*Go north and talk to Denath. {{Chat option|4I forgot the incantation.}} (or {{Chat option|2I forgot the incantation.}} during the ritual). '''Write down''' the incantation he tells you as it is used '''twice''' during the quest.
*Complete the circle and click the sigil in your inventory to chant the incantation (unequip the Silverlight if nothing happens).
*TAKE THE DEMONIC SIGIL DENATH DROPPED ON THE FLOOR. (If you do not, you will have to create another Demonic sigil)
*Enter the portal to exit the room and take Tanya's sigil.
*Tell Evil Dave to return to the lair {{Chat option|2You've got to get back to the throne room!}} – you should have 4 sigils now.}}
